inputs.prompt:
Three-shot sequence, hard cuts, cold blue dusk with amber accents, anamorphic.
SHOT ONE: wide static shot from the ice, the figure standing small beside the parked sedan, the pyramid-shaped hull filling the sky above the mountains, snow drifting across the frame.
HARD CUT.
SHOT TWO: close on a cluster of thrusters under the hull, bell nozzles rimed with frost, heat burning the frost off into vapour, a ring of amber light kindling deep inside the bells, one nozzle flexing slightly on its gimbal.
HARD CUT.
SHOT THREE: the thrusters fire and it rises straight up, ice blasting outward in a ring across the lake, the hull climbing past the top of frame, the camera tilting up to follow it into the dusk sky, the figure left small on the bare ice, the sedan's taillight still orange.
Audio: a deep organ drone, a rising thruster whine, then a pressure roar dropping into silence. 5 seconds.
